title: SmartByte-ML: Flood Risk Prediction Demo
summary: An educational machine learning demo project that trains a regression model to predict flood risk from environmental and infrastructural indicators and deploys it via a Flask API. Its data_synthesis.ipynb notebook uses SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer with SingleTableMetadata to generate the artificial flood dataset used for training.
evidence: scoring_system/data_synthesis.ipynb:1084 'synthesizer = GaussianCopulaSynthesizer(metadata)' then fit/sample to produce synthetic_data
